text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Another bomb blast in Lagos, 12 soldiers injured.
- Port Harcourt International Airport may be reopened today following removal from the runway of the DC 8 cargo plane which made a crash landing on Tuesday.
- The chairman of the National Economic Intelligence Committee has praised the management of the Port Harcourt oil refinery for being able to sustain operations despite a lack of money.
- The chairman of Union Bank of Nigeria says younger people should have been picked to sit on the military government's "Vision 2010" committee that is working out a long term economic plan.
- A mass retirement of senior officers in the armed forces may be imminent.
- Britain's Virgin Atlantic Airways has developed cold feet over a possible deal with Nigeria Airways, sources at the aviation ministry say.
- Nigerian Bottling Company says it will invest in the latest equipment and staff training to ensure it maintains its position as Nigeria's leading soft drinks company.
